description: tonyd2wild's original DeepSeek-V4-Flash (pre-0731 release) profile on two Sparks: vLLM tensor parallel 2 without Ray, FP8 KV cache, DeepSeek MTP with two drafted tokens, b12x MoE kernels and a 1,000,000-token context on aidendle94's published vLLM fork image (digest-pinned, used unmodified). Upstream's 500K rollback profile is a memory option plus the context and concurrency settings (500000 and 8). Same-creator alternatives for this Spark count with the 0731 checkpoint are the DSpark recipes. Licences (information only): recipe MIT, model MIT. Upstream figures (about 45.5 tok/s single stream at MTP 2, 2.84M-token KV pool at 1M context) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. The first request after boot can time out while autotune and warmup finish. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.82 with no explicit KV pool and a 1,000,000-token context, as in tonyd2wild's launch/ds4-1m-launch.sh at 7cc2c55c (line 30); upstream notes that higher utilization runs out of memory at this context (README line 110), and its 500K rollback profile (0.80, 500000 tokens, 8 sequences; launch/ds4-500k-launch.sh line 30) is the memory option. The steady per-node peak is 0.82 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 6 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash MTP vLLM two Sparks (tonyd2wild)
